# rksafe.sys ![:inline](/images/twitter_verified.png) 

### Description

Nextron Systems identifies this rksafe sample as a rootkit with input interception, anti-debugging, minifilter callbacks, and process protection. Static analysis confirms cross-process memory read/write routines, minifilter registration with a communication port, process and thread object callbacks, and logic that clears KdDebuggerEnabled. Input interception and successful runtime protection effects were not independently tested.
- **UUID**: 5cbb1918-f7ac-4de8-b334-0bb4824a516b
- **Created**: 2026-09-08
- **Author**: Michael Haag
- **Acknowledgement**: Nextron Systems Research | [@nextronresearch](https://twitter.com/@nextronresearch)
